title: Config
description:
The server's `config.toml`. Secrets never go here: they come from the
environment (`SESSION_SECRET`, `SESSION_SECRET_PREV`, `TURN_SECRET`).

allow_localhost.description: Accept `http://localhost:*` and `http://127.0.0.1:*` origins for every app. For local development only.

apps.description: One `[apps.<id>]` table per game. The id is what the client passes as `app`.

limits.description: Token lifetimes, grace periods, room ages and rate limits.

listen.description: Address and port to listen on.

trusted_proxies.description:
Reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` is believed, as IP ranges. From any other peer the header is
ignored and the socket address is the client, so per-IP limits hold with or without a proxy in front.
The default covers a proxy on the same host or a private (Docker) network.

turn.description: TURN relay offered to clients through `POST /turn`. Leave out to disable TURN for every app.

list.description: What `list` returns: `"all"` lists public rooms, `"none"` lists nothing.

max_players.description: Most members in a room, host included. A room can ask for fewer.

max_rooms.description: Most rooms open at once for this app.

origins.description: Page origins allowed to use this app, e.g. `https://example.github.io`. An origin has no path.

public_rooms.description: Allow public rooms, which can be joined with the code alone. Otherwise `create` with `public: true` fails with `public_disabled`.

turn.description: Hand out TURN credentials to this app's sessions. Needs a top-level `[turn]` table.

Limits.description: Timeouts and rate limits, shared by all apps.

app_failed_joins_per_min.description: Failed joins and peeks (`not_found`, `bad_key`) per app per minute, across all IPs.

grace_secs.description: How long a member who dropped keeps their slot (and a host keeps the room) waiting for a resume, in seconds.

idle_room_secs.description: A room whose host has been alone this long is closed, in seconds.

joins_per_min.description: Join and peek attempts per client IP per minute.

room_max_age_secs.description: A room older than this is closed, in seconds.

session_ttl_secs.description: Lifetime of a session token from `POST /session`, in seconds. The client renews it before it expires.

sessions_per_min.description: Session tokens minted per client IP per minute.

oneOf.description: Public rooms for the caller's version, nearby first (docs/specs/handshake-server.md "Public listing").
Nothing: a public room is joinable with its code, but its code is never listed.

TurnConfig.description: The companion coturn server. Its `static-auth-secret` must equal `TURN_SECRET`.

ttl_secs.description: Lifetime of a TURN credential, in seconds.

urls.description: `stun:`, `turn:` and `turns:` URLs handed to clients, e.g. `turn:turn.example.com:3478?transport=udp`.
